messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Hey @Marco — sharing a compact first-week agenda + a 30/60/90 starter. Can you skim and assign owners for the role-specific items? I kept it short for an IC eng manager join. :memo: For context, Sam starts Monday.
Marco (Eng Manager): Thanks! Posting my quick pass. I can own tech intro, team 1:1s, and product walkthrough. Need you to confirm access timelines for infra/console.

Aisha (People Ops): Great — please mark anything you want shifted. Draft agenda (copyable):
```
Day 0 (pre-start): Laptop shipped & account invites; welcome email + Slack intro
Day 1: HR paperwork AM, team intro + standup, tech setup w/ IT, repo access, lunch w/ team
Day 2: Product deep-dive, architecture overview, first tiny task + pairing
Day 3: Observability & runtime walkthrough, deploy basics, security training
Day 4: Customer context, support rotation overview, shadowing
Day 5: 1-week sync + goals for next 30 days
30/60/90: goals template (skills, deliverables, check-ins)
```

Elena (IT): Laptop is en route (UPS) and should arrive by Friday. VPN cert + SSO invite will be sent 24h before start. If you need faster access, reply with Sam's personal email.

Marco (Eng Manager): Copy. Can you make sure Sam gets staging access day 2? He'll need read access earlier for the architecture docs. Also tagging @Onboarding Bot to create the calendar blocks.

Onboarding Bot: Created calendar events: "Sam — Week 1: 1:1s & Tech Kickoff" (Mon 10:00), "Product Walkthrough" (Tue 11:00), "Observability" (Wed 14:00). Shared with Marco, Sam, Elena, and Aisha.

Sam (New Hire): Thanks everyone — excited! Quick Q: who do I ping for repo access if I get 403s?

Marco (Eng Manager): Ping me first and I'll triage — but if it's infra-level block, loop in Elena with a screenshot. Typical flow: me -> eng-infra -> Elena.

Aisha (People Ops): Who-to-ask cheat sheet (short):
- Laptop / VPN / SSO: Elena (IT)
- Repo / CI perms: Marco (Eng Manager) then eng-infra
- HR/payroll / benefits: Aisha (People Ops)
- Slack / calendar issues: Onboarding Bot (or @People Ops)

Marco (Eng Manager): I'll add a small 30/60/90 plan and post in the hiring tracker later today. For immediate priorities: (1) get staging read access, (2) schedule pairing with Sasha for first bug, (3) add to observability sprint channel.

Aisha (People Ops): Perfect. I'll send the Slack intro post Friday and include the one-liner bio you suggested. Any blockers before Monday? :point_down:

Sam (New Hire): No blockers on my side. I did get the UPS tracking. Appreciate the clarity — see you Monday! :smile:
